Sinnock and Smith state the table as the melting point's, 115.95 K, 0.18 K above the registry row's triple point, 115.77 K, which the file takes, so that the sim's carry starts at the row's state; the difference is recorded, not applied. Sinnock 1980 (J. Phys. C 13, 2375, DOI 10.1088/0022-3719/13/12/018; its abstract, through OpenAlex, https://api.openalex.org/works/doi:10.1088/0022-3719/13/12/018, SHA-256 ae4a1333216d5a49a141bf8784598d71a5bc88c053e8133eb6b5249fe69fa817, fetched 2026-10-16) measured the condensed noble gases again by total internal reflection: "values for krypton obtained by the two methods differ by more than the combined experimental error". Seidel, Lanou and Yao 2002's specific refractions (arXiv:hep-ex/0111054, Table II, after Sinnock 1980; the arXiv PDF, https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-ex/0111054, SHA-256 851f31ed333ec5dc669da52154ae294c42ae6225e0c02b9c31c4cf7a85a45574, fetched 2026-10-16) put the liquid's against the dilute gas's at 0.1045 and 0.1050 cm³ g⁻¹ for Ar, 0.0771 and 0.0765 for Kr and 0.0801 and 0.0788 for Xe: the heavy atoms' liquids run above the gas, as the record's Kr and Xe rows do.
